nable.description: Local-first FinOps server for cloud and AI spend. Answers cost questions across AWS, Azure, GCP, Kubernetes and 15+ SaaS and AI providers, detects anomalies against a rolling baseline, tracks LLM spend by model, and drafts the Terraform fix as a pull request a human reviews. Runs on your machine: credentials stay in your OS keyring and cost data caches in a local SQLite database. Propose-only, so it never changes your cloud on its own.
